context: Two news editors discuss a press release that needs a correction
purpose: Teach: 警告/証言/証人/言及/通過/評論/訂正/反発

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先輩、昨日のプレスリリース、裁判の証人の名前が間違ってました。すぐに訂正を出すべきだと思います。
lines.en: Senior, yesterday's press release had the wrong name for the trial witness. I think we should issue a correction right away.
lines.style: Junior male news editor, polite but urgent tone, slightly anxious

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本当?どの部分?もし政策に関する言及だったら、業界の反発を招くかもしれないわよ。
lines.en: Really? Which part? If it referenced policy, it could provoke industry backlash.
lines.style: Female senior editor, measured professional tone with calm concern

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 議会を通過した法案の関連裁判です。匿名の情報源から、証人の証言を取り違えていると警告を受けました。
lines.en: It's the trial linked to the bill that passed the assembly. An anonymous source warned me we mixed up the witness's testimony.
lines.style: Junior male editor, factual delivery with a hint of nervous formality

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 情報源が匿名なのは仕方ないけど、せめて裁判所の公式コメントが一つ取れないと、評論家にまた叩かれる。
lines.en: An anonymous source can't be helped, but without an official court comment, the commentators will tear into us again.
lines.style: Female senior editor, slightly tense and pragmatic, weighing professional risk

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 裁判所の広報担当が、午後三時に正式なコメントをくれると約束してくれました。
lines.en: The court's PR officer promised to give us an official comment at three this afternoon.
lines.style: Junior male editor, regaining confidence, reporting in slightly relieved tone

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: よし。じゃあ三時を過ぎたら、訂正記事を上に通して、夕刊に間に合わせましょう。
lines.en: Good. Once three passes, let's push the correction article upstairs and make the evening edition.
lines.style: Female senior editor, decisive and brisk, taking command of the situation

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解です。評論欄の担当にも、この件に言及があるかもしれないと伝えておきます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll let the opinion column staff know there may be a mention of this matter too.
lines.style: Junior male editor, businesslike and cooperative, wrapping up the plan
